audience.title: Audience

skills.name: discovery
skills.title: Creator discovery
skills.description: Find creators by platform, tier, who they've posted for, and whether they've ever posted for you. Ranked with live performance from the latest snapshot.
skills.example: 50 nano creators competitors used on TikTok in the last 90 days, never used by us

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

used_by.description: Brands the creator must have posted for in the window

exclude_used_by.description: Brands the creator must NOT have posted for in the window. Default: the client brand when the workspace has one, else empty

min_followers.description: Ignore accounts below this many followers (also excludes unknown follower counts)

min_views.description: Minimum total views across the creator's posts in the window; keeps rate rankings (comment_rate, er_pct) from surfacing accounts with a few hundred views

skills.name: mercenaries
skills.title: Mercenaries
skills.description: Creators who posted for several competitors inside the window. See who's for hire, who's saturated, and who just posted for a rival.
skills.example: Which creators worked for 4+ brands in the last 90 days, and for whom?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: loyalists
skills.title: Loyalists
skills.description: Creators a brand keeps month after month. Only ~15% of top creators return, so this shows who each brand retains and who is about to churn.
skills.example: Who has Skintific kept for three months straight?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: affiliates
skills.title: Affiliate detection
skills.description: Sizes each brand's affiliate network on TikTok. Rule: a post with a shoppable (yellow cart) link is an affiliate post; a creator with at least one affiliate post in the window is an affiliator. Stricter volume-based settings are optional. Resellers are counted separately.
skills.example: How big is MS Glow's affiliate network on TikTok, and is it growing?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

month.description: YYYY-MM; alternative to window. Default: window (last 30 days of data)

min_cart_posts.description: Affiliator = creator with at least this many cart posts in the window

strict_min_posts.description: Optional stricter rule: also require at least this many posts in the window (PRD used 30)

strict_min_cart_pct.description: Optional stricter rule: also require this cart share of the creator's posts (PRD used 50)

skills.name: breakout
skills.title: Breakout creators
skills.description: Small accounts whose posts travel far beyond their followers. Catches a 200-follower creator doing 2M views the week it happens.
skills.example: Nano creators doing 5 views per follower or more this week

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

min_views_per_1k.description: Minimum views per 1,000 followers. 5000 means 5 views per follower.

min_followers.description: Ignore accounts below this many followers; tiny follower counts make views-per-follower meaningless

skills.name: funnel-mix
skills.title: Funnel mix
skills.description: Scores a brand's creator mix by funnel stage. Mega creators drive awareness; micro and nano carry carts. Compare any brand's mix with yours.
skills.example: Is Glad2Glow buying awareness or conversion this month?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

compare_to.description: Brands to compare with. Default: client brand when the workspace has one, else none

month.description: YYYY-MM; default latest month in the data

skills.name: overlap
skills.title: Creator overlap
skills.description: Which competitors hire from the same creator pool. A talent map of the category, with the creators shared between any two brands.
skills.example: Which brands share creators with Timephoria?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: velocity
skills.title: Post velocity
skills.description: Which posts are still climbing on day 3 of their 7-day tracking. Momentum, not totals, so you see what's going viral before it has.
skills.example: Competitor posts from this week that are still accelerating

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: forecast
skills.title: Post forecast
skills.description: Projects a post's day-7 views from its first day, using tier-specific curves learned from history. Decide on day 2 whether to boost, repost, or move on.
skills.example: Will yesterday's @skinbyalya post clear 500K by Sunday?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: waves
skills.title: Creator waves
skills.description: Detects a creator burst as it starts: an unusual number of creators posting for one brand within days. Alerts on day 2, not in the monthly report.
skills.example: Is any competitor running a launch wave right now?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: top-content
skills.title: Top content
skills.description: Best posts by views, comment rate, or engagement rate, filtered by brand, affiliate (cart) tag, content format, product category, tier and platform. The evidence is the posts themselves.
skills.example: Most performing content with affiliate tags last month

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

has_cart.description: true = only posts with a shoppable link (TikTok); false = only posts without

min_views.description: Floor applied when ranking by a rate

skills.name: compare
skills.title: Brand compare
skills.description: Any brands side by side on volume, creators, views, engagements, cart share, and (Phase 2) sentiment and top comment topics. Owned and earned reported separately.
skills.example: My brand vs Skintific, Somethinc and Emina, last 30 days

compare_prev.description: Also compute the previous equal window and deltas

skills.name: launch
skills.title: Launch read
skills.description: A week-by-week read of a product launch: creator wave, new vs returning creators, cart share, and (Phase 2) comment topics and unanswered questions.
skills.example: How is Skintific's 5X Ceramide serum doing, four weeks in?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: brand-strategy
skills.title: Brand strategy
skills.description: One brand, one month or ISO week: posts, creators, tier mix, owned vs earned (TikTok), cart share, content format mix, product category mix, top 10 posts, and week-by-week volume. The fastest way to read what a competitor is doing.
skills.example: Tell me Skintific's strategy in June

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

month.description: YYYY-MM. Default: latest month in the data

week.description: ISO week, e.g. 2026-W24; alternative to month

skills.name: objections
skills.title: Objections
skills.description: Why people aren't buying, from the comments under any brand's posts: price, availability, skin type, halal, packaging. Ranked and trended.
skills.example: Top objections under Emina posts this month vs last

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: questions
skills.title: Unanswered questions
skills.description: What people ask under competitor posts that nobody answers. Unanswered questions are your next content brief.
skills.example: Most common unanswered questions under serum posts

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: dupes
skills.title: Dupe map
skills.description: Comments comparing brands ("mirip X tapi lebih murah") build a substitution map. See which brands people treat as interchangeable with yours.
skills.example: Which brands get compared to mine, and on what?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: claims
skills.title: Claims vs trust
skills.description: What creators claim about a product, and whether the comments believe it. Claim versus trust, per creator and per brand.
skills.example: Which "7-day barrier" claims did commenters push back on?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: whitespace
skills.title: Whitespace
skills.description: Topics rising in category comments that no brand's own content addresses yet. Where the conversation is going before anyone owns it.
skills.example: What are people asking for that no beauty brand is talking about?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: seeding
skills.title: Seeding detection
skills.description: Coordinated comment activity: repeated phrasing, timing clusters, and account patterns on any brand's posts. Flags the incident and estimates its size.
skills.example: Is anyone seeding comments on Wardah right now?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: audience
skills.title: Audience overlap
skills.description: Real audience overlap from commenter handles across all tracked brands. How many of a competitor's commenters have also commented on you.
skills.example: What share of Skintific's commenters also engage with my brand?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: switchers
skills.title: Switchers
skills.description: Commenters active on one brand who moved to another over time. Where a brand's audience is leaking to, and where yours is coming from.
skills.example: Who commented on Somethinc in April and on Skintific in June?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: superfans
skills.title: Superfans
skills.description: Repeat commenters on a brand, ranked. Your future nano creators, community seeds, and the first people to notice when something is wrong.
skills.example: My 100 most frequent commenters this quarter

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace

skills.name: narrative
skills.title: Narrative watch
skills.description: Text-first narratives on Threads and X before they reach video: complaints, rumours, price talk. Usually the earliest signal you'll get. Unavailable until Threads or X data is loaded.
skills.example: What are people saying about my brand on Threads this week?

brands.description: Brand slugs; default = all tracked brands in the workspace
